name: libyaml document loading (parser → composer)
description:
yaml_parser_load reads raw, untrusted YAML byte input (string/file/custom reader) and composes it into an in-memory document tree (yaml_document_t of yaml_node_t nodes for scalars, sequences and mappings), resolving anchors/aliases and tag directives along the way. This is the highest-value fuzzing surface in libyaml because it drives the full pipeline: byte reader -> UTF-8/16/32 decoding -> lexical scanner (tokens) -> event-level parser (state machine covering block/flow sequences, mappings, documents, directives) -> composer (loader.c) that builds the node stack, registers anchors, and resolves alias back-references. Bugs here (buffer handling in the scanner, stack growth, duplicate/dangling anchor handling, mapping/sequence node construction) are classic memory-safety targets.
- yaml_parser_load: entry point/target; pulls parse events via yaml_parser_parse and composes a yaml_document_t (loader.c: yaml_parser_load_document -> yaml_parser_load_nodes -> yaml_parser_load_alias/scalar/sequence/mapping/*_end), exercising the whole scan+parse+compose core.
- yaml_parser_initialize: lifecycle setup required before any parsing; must be called first.
- yaml_parser_set_input_string / yaml_parser_set_input_file / yaml_parser_set_input: sources — select how the raw fuzz bytes are fed to the reader (in-memory buffer vs FILE* vs custom read handler), feeding the scanner's reader.c buffer-fill logic.
- yaml_parser_set_encoding: configuration — forces UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE decoding path in reader.c instead of autodetecting from the BOM, changing which decode branch in the reader processes the bytes.
- yaml_parser_parse: variant — lower-level event API used internally by yaml_parser_load (can also be called directly/alternately to exercise yaml_parser_state_machine and all its sub-state handlers for block/flow scalars, sequences, mappings, directives, anchors and tags without composing a document).
- yaml_document_get_root_node / yaml_document_get_node: consumers — traverse the composed document returned by yaml_parser_load, walking into the node arrays (sequence.items, mapping.pairs) built by the composer, exercising node-array/content-correctness paths.
- yaml_document_delete: lifecycle cleanup needed between repeated yaml_parser_load calls (a stream can contain multiple documents) and on error paths.
Input space to vary from the fuzz bytes: document content/structure (plain/quoted/block/folded scalars, flow vs block sequences and mappings, nested anchors "&name"/aliases "*name", duplicate anchors, %YAML and %TAG directives, multiple documents "---"/"..." separators, comments, explicit vs implicit document start/end, BOM presence selecting UTF-8/16 encoding, and which yaml_parser_set_input* source/yaml_parser_set_encoding value is used to feed/interpret the same bytes).
